scientific_integrity: The pinned spectrum and circle law are identified as prior published work; the submitted contribution is a Jordan classification and dynamic growth boundary. The proof is finite-dimensional and symbolic tests illustrate it, not independently certify it.
scientific_limitations: Uniform hopping; antipodal imaginary on-site gain and loss; finite even cycles; non-Hermitian single-particle amplitude dynamics only. Historical equivalence beyond inspected sources remains possible.
title: Real-spectrum exceptional points and polynomial growth on antipodal gain–loss rings
